name: Almost Heaven Oasis 4-Person Indoor Sauna
description: Almost Heaven Oasis 4-Person Indoor Sauna Introducing the Oasis 4-Person Sauna from Almost Heaven Saunas, where luxury and relaxation converge in a spacious sanctuary designed for your well-being. With exterior dimensions of 83-1/4"W x 63-3/4"D x 79-3/8"H and interior dimensions of 78-3/4"W x 60-1/4"D x 77-3/8"H, the Oasis offers ample space for you and three companions to unwind and rejuvenate. Featuring multi-level seating with an upper bench measuring 78"L x 24"W x 37-3/8"H and a lower bench measuring 78"L x 15-3/8"W x 22-7/8"H, this sauna ensures comfort for all users. Crafted from premium Hemfir or Rustic Cedar lumber, the Oasis exudes both elegance and durability. Experience the soothing warmth of the Harvia 8kW Wall Series heater, providing efficient heat for a truly indulgent sauna experience. Plus, with the option to upgrade the heater to models such as KIPW, Spirit, Virta, or Cilindro Series, you can tailor your sauna to your exact preferences. Invest in your well-being with the Oasis 4-Person Sauna, where luxury meets tranquility for an unparalleled sauna experience.
